draft_note: Suite membership drafted in V2-001. Numeric tolerances and performance targets are set and the plan is frozen (status 'frozen') in the calibration task before optimization/qualification. Until then this plan is not acceptance evidence.

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: for each species and material, transport stopping power agrees with the held-out ion-specific evaluation table within tolerance T_S over the documented energy domain; Monte Carlo R80 in water agrees with the CSDA-derived range from that table within T_R. Numeric T_S and T_R are set at freeze from the calibration/research record.
suites.rationale: Ion-specific stopping/range evidence is required per species; proton data cannot validate heavier ions (V2-ION, V2-EVID).
suites.independent_evidence: ion-specific-tabulated evaluation tables (PSTAR/ASTAR/ICRU 90 lineage) with construction/evaluation roles recorded

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: proton pristine Bragg curves (70-230 MeV) and lateral profiles in water versus independent Monte Carlo (TOPAS/Geant4) and measured/analytic references: R80 within T_R80, distal 80-20 within T_fall, normalized depth dose within T_dose (local) proximal to the peak, lateral sigma within T_sig.
suites.rationale: Depth dose and lateral spread are the primary planning observables; evidence must be independent of the implementation.
suites.independent_evidence: independent Monte Carlo (TOPAS), measured/analytic Bragg-curve references

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: primary proton fluence attenuation versus depth and secondary-particle dose fraction versus TOPAS within tolerances; disabling nuclear physics changes the distal/plateau dose by the expected magnitude (discriminating test).
suites.rationale: Nuclear attenuation and secondaries change the plateau by roughly 10-15% for 200 MeV protons; the model must be evidenced, not just enabled.
suites.independent_evidence: independent Monte Carlo (TOPAS), published cross-section evaluations

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: slab phantoms (bone, lung, adipose inserts) and the explicit heterogeneous planning variant versus TOPAS and a second engine (MCsquare/FRED) with range shift and dose agreement within tolerances.
suites.rationale: Material/density handling is central to patient-like planning geometries.

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: helium-4 Bragg curves and lateral profiles in water versus TOPAS and ion-specific tabulated range data within tolerances; nuclear attenuation evidenced.

DRAFT: carbon-12 (150-400 MeV/u) Bragg curves, primary attenuation, fragment fluence build-up by charge and distal fragment dose tail versus TOPAS and measured fragmentation data within tolerances; species contributions scored.
suites.rationale: Carbon nuclear physics and fragment dose are central release requirements.
suites.independent_evidence: independent Monte Carlo (TOPAS/Geant4 QMD or BIC), measured fragment yields where accessible

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: oxygen-16 Bragg curve and attenuation versus TOPAS and ion-specific range data within tolerances over a documented supported domain; unsupported channels raise errors.
suites.rationale: Oxygen needs a documented supported domain with ion-specific validation.
suites.independent_evidence: independent Monte Carlo (TOPAS), ion-specific tabulated stopping data

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: dose- and track-averaged LET in water for protons and mixed carbon fields versus TOPAS LET scorers and analytic single-species limits within tolerances.
suites.rationale: LET is a required planning observable and depends on estimator definitions.
suites.independent_evidence: independent Monte Carlo (TOPAS LET scorers), analytic limits

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: step-size, scoring-grid refinement/shift, boundary alignment, translated/outside sources, finite-phantom escape accounting, float32/float64, beam orientation probes yield changes within predeclared stability bounds or the domain is rejected.
suites.rationale: Adversarial numerical falsification is a v2 MUST.

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: batch uncertainty coverage within predeclared bounds; uncertainty of dose and secondary/fragment estimators scales as 1/sqrt(N); seeds and batch counts reproduce statistically.
suites.rationale: Undefined uncertainty must not masquerade as zero.

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: reference Python, Warp CPU and Warp CUDA agree statistically on identical configurations (z-score criteria on voxel dose, integral quantities exact within float tolerance); deterministic per-backend reproducibility.
suites.rationale: Backends share the physics model; parity is equivalence, not accuracy evidence.

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: every public path honors or rejects requested physics/scoring/influence flags with discriminating tests; requested and effective configuration persisted.
suites.rationale: Fail-closed capability contract is a v2 MUST.

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: user-provided species/energy(/material) lookup tables produce tallies matching fluence-weighted expectations in controlled cases, with provenance recorded.
suites.rationale: External biological lookup functionality must be demonstrated nontrivially.

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: persisted results reopened in a separate clean process recover all V2-OUTPUT fields; influence matrices retain geometry/beamlet/unit/history metadata.
suites.rationale: Self-describing results are a release requirement.

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: external datasets are acquired automatically, cached, versioned, hash-verified, offline-reusable and identified in outputs.
DRAFT: each performance.json workload measured with full enabled physics meets every ratified numeric target; scaling series recorded.

DRAFT: the documented workflow (install, data acquisition, source/geometry/scoring definition, run, dose/LET/uncertainty/influence outputs, offline reuse) succeeds from a clean installation; failures are acceptance failures.
suites.rationale: A product, not internal tests, is the deliverable.

suites.acceptance: DRAFT: automated tests, CI, pre-commit and documentation build pass; the qualification report covers every MUST.
